fact: On 10 December 2024 appointments were handed to 133 statisticians for the ministerial statistical services, set up under the 2020 statistics law, which the INEGE director general says was promulgated in 2020.
title: Entrega de nombramientos a los técnicos de estadísticas de los departamentos ministeriales
publisher: Oficina de Información y Prensa de Guinea Ecuatorial
